article.headline: Telegram CEO says an extortionist planted CSAM in a chat to get it pulled from the App Store
article.summary: Telegram CEO Pavel Durov blames an extortionist for planting child sexual abuse material (CSAM) in a public chat to get the app temporarily removed from Apple's App Store on Monday night. "Apple removed Telegram from the App Store before contacting us," Durov says in a post on X. "This creates a potential systemic risk…
